content:
elena: FYI seeing a spike of SAML failures after the idp-proxy rollout at 02:00 UTC. ~3% of logins show 'Signature validation failed' and SCIM jobs for a few orgs are queuing up. Not a full outage but customers are hitting 403s.

sam: which orgs? any error examples? can you paste the assertion failure stack?

elena: repro from prod logs for org acme-co: 
```
ERROR 2026-03-21T02:12:46Z auth.saml: Assertion validation error: Signature verification failed (kid mismatch)
RequestID=req_8f3a user=alice@acme-co.com idp_issuer=https://idp.acme/saml2
```

elena: SCIM syncs show delayed provisioning attempts (3xx->429 backoff). KMS decrypt logs look clean.

mike: did we rotate the proxy certs or the idp certs yesterday? I remember a quick cert refresh for the proxy edge.

elena: @mike we rotated the proxy TLS certs (edge cert) but did NOT touch idp metadata. signatures are on SAML XML not TLS, though.

sam: kid mismatch usually means IdP rotated their signing key. Can you fetch the IdP metadata and check x509 cert thumbprint vs what we're caching?

elena: grabbing metadata now: `curl -s https://idp.acme/.well-known/saml-metadata | xmllint --xpath 'string(//ds:X509Certificate)' -`

elena: metadata cert fingerprint: SHA1=3A:7C:...:9B (truncated)

sam: our cached thumbprint in the JWKS/kms mapping is SHA1=21:4F:...:B2 — that's the mismatch. looks like idp rotated and we didn't auto-refresh metadata for that idp.

mike: why didn't the metadata refresh trigger? should be on a 1h poll. check the idp-proxy heartbeat + metadata-fetch logs. maybe upstream started returning 304s with broken cache headers.

elena: checking proxy logs: `kubectl logs deploy/idp-proxy -n auth --since=3h | grep metadata-fetch`

elena: found entries: 
```
INFO metadata-fetcher: got 200 for idp.acme/saml-metadata 02:00:10
INFO metadata-fetcher: stored cert thumbprint 21:4F:...:B2 02:00:10
WARN metadata-fetcher: failed to update cache - upstream returned 304, no-body 02:59:59
```

elena: sequence is weird: our store updated at 02:00 but IdP rotated sometime between 02:00 and 02:12. They might have rolled without bumping metadata's cache-control so our fetcher saw 304 and didn't pull new cert.

sam: we should have a fingerprint-verification on auth failure: if signature verification fails, trigger a forced metadata refresh once (with backoff) before failing the auth. ticket that.

mike: agree. short-term: manual flush for acme-co metadata and redeploy proxy or force fetch. long-term: implement verification-on-fail plus jittered metadata refresh.

elena: I've forced a metadata fetch and restarted idp-proxy pod in prod for acme-co. replays show alice login now succeeds. monitoring for 30m.

deploy-bot: Restarted deployment/idp-proxy in namespace auth: 1 pod rolled. (intent: force metadata refresh) :white_check_mark:

devsec-bot: Runbook: Identity provider rotated signing key — steps applied: 1) force metadata fetch 2) clear cache for affected issuer 3) monitor auth success rate. Recommend: add instrumentation for 'kid mismatch' counter and auto-refresh attempt. https://internal.runbooks/redwood/idp-rotation

sam: also check SCIM queue consumer: some orgs hit 429 because provisioning tokens were rejected earlier. if metadata mismatch caused session signature failures, SCIM jobs might have retried and tripped client-side backoff. purge/requeue once auth stable.

elena: doing SCIM requeue for affected orgs now. will follow up if anything else pops up.

mike: postmortem notes: update metadata fetcher to respect Last-Modified/ETag but also support force-refresh on verification errors; add alert if >0.5% auth failures with signature errors in 5m window.

elena: thanks all, keeping this thread updated. :thumbsup:
